lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.unitTitle: Mathematical Habits and Place Value to One Million
lessonRef.focus: a digit represents ten times what it represents to its right
lessonRef.title: Concept build A: a digit represents ten times what it represents to its right

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: Study both examples. The second one drops some of the wording of the first.

items.prompt: The digit 3 is in the thousands place in one number, and the digit 3 is in the hundreds place in another. How many times as great is the first?

steps: Thousands is one place left of hundreds.
Each place is 10 times the place to its right.
The first digit is 10 times as great.

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Work these with your teaching adult. Say the reason for each step out loud before you write it.

items.prompt: A digit 4 is in the thousands place in one number, and the digit 4 is in the hundreds place in another number. How many times as great is the first digit's value compared to the second?
A digit 3 is in the tens place in one number, and the digit 3 is in the ones place in another number. How many times as great is the first digit's value compared to the second?
A digit 7 is in the hundreds place in one number, and the digit 7 is in the tens place in another number. How many times as great is the first digit's value compared to the second?

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: A digit 2 is in the hundreds place in one number, and the digit 2 is in the tens place in another number. How many times as great is the first digit's value compared to the second?
A digit 3 is in the thousands place in one number, and the digit 3 is in the hundreds place in another number. How many times as great is the first digit's value compared to the second?
A digit 3 is in the hundreds place in one number, and the digit 3 is in the tens place in another number. How many times as great is the first digit's value compared to the second?

sections.title: Mastery check
sections.directions: Mastery check. Work without help, then stop and hand this section in.

items.prompt: A digit 4 is in the tens place in one number, and the digit 4 is in the ones place in another number. How many times as great is the first digit's value compared to the second?
